question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets.

In this (endeavour) __________, he met with vigorous opponents.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Inactivity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Endeavour"** means a determined effort to achieve something. It refers to attempting or striving for a goal. (प्रयास)
 
 
• **Example:** His endeavour to improve his skills paid off with a promotion.
 
 
 
• **"Inactivity"** refers to a lack of action, movement, or effort. It is the opposite of endeavour, as it denotes idleness or passivity. (निष्क्रियता)
 
 
• **Example:** Prolonged inactivity can lead to a decline in physical health.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of "endeavour" is "inactivity".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Inactivity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Force** (बल): Refers to physical power or strength exerted on something.
 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers used force to break through the enemy's defenses.
 
 
 
• **Business** (व्यापार): Refers to commercial activity or work related to trade or services.
 
 
• **Example:** He runs a successful business selling handmade crafts.
 
 
 
• **Design** (डिज़ाइन): Refers to a plan or drawing created to show the appearance and function of something before it is made.
 
 
• **Example:** The architect presented a stunning design for the new building.
